# package apci

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-iec104/apci"
```

Package apci implements the IEC 60870-5-104 Application Protocol Control Information: APDU framing, the I/S/U control field formats, 15-bit sequence number arithmetic and the protocol parameters (k, w, t0..t3).

The package is pure encode/decode: it owns no sockets, timers or state machines. The connection state machine built on top of it is shared by [github.com/otfabric/go-iec104/client](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec104/client) and [github.com/otfabric/go-iec104/server](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/otfabric/go-iec104/server).

## Constants

```go
const (
	// StartByte is the first octet of every APDU.
	StartByte = 0x68

	// ControlLength is the size of the control field in octets.
	ControlLength = 4

	// HeaderLength is the size of the start octet plus the length octet.
	HeaderLength = 2

	// MaxAPDULength is the largest value of the APDU length octet: the
	// control field plus the ASDU.
	MaxAPDULength = 253

	// MaxASDULength is the largest ASDU an I-format APDU can carry.
	MaxASDULength = MaxAPDULength - ControlLength

	// MaxFrameLength is the largest APDU on the wire, including the start
	// and length octets.
	MaxFrameLength = HeaderLength + MaxAPDULength
)
```

```go
const (
	// SeqModulus is the modulus of the send and receive sequence numbers.
	SeqModulus = 1 << 15

	// SeqMask masks a value to the 15-bit sequence number range.
	SeqMask = SeqModulus - 1
)
```

```go
const DefaultPort = 2404
```

DefaultPort is the IANA-registered TCP port for IEC 60870-5-104.

```go
const DefaultTLSPort = 19998
```

DefaultTLSPort is the port IEC 62351-3 assigns to IEC 60870-5-104 over TLS.

	ErrInvalidStart = errors.New("apci: invalid start byte")

## Functions

### func SeqAcks

```go
func SeqAcks(nr, ack, next uint16) (n int, ok bool)
```

SeqAcks reports whether a received N(R) of nr is a valid acknowledgement for a sender whose oldest unacknowledged frame is ack and whose next send sequence number is next, and how many frames it newly acknowledges.

nr is valid when it lies in the closed range ack..next, modulo SeqModulus.

### func SeqDiff

```go
func SeqDiff(a, b uint16) int
```

SeqDiff returns how far a is ahead of b, modulo SeqModulus: the number of increments that turn b into a.

### func SeqNext

```go
func SeqNext(n uint16) uint16
```

SeqNext returns the sequence number following n.

### type Frame

```go
type Frame struct {
	Format   Format
	SendSeq  uint16
	RecvSeq  uint16
	Function UFunction
	ASDU     []byte
}
```

Frame is one decoded APDU.

SendSeq is meaningful for I frames, RecvSeq for I and S frames, Function for U frames and ASDU for I frames.

#### func NewI

```go
func NewI(sendSeq, recvSeq uint16, asdu []byte) Frame
```

NewI returns an I-format frame carrying asdu. The slice is not copied.

#### func NewS

```go
func NewS(recvSeq uint16) Frame
```

NewS returns an S-format frame acknowledging every I frame up to, but not including, recvSeq.

#### func NewU

```go
func NewU(fn UFunction) Frame
```

NewU returns a U-format frame for fn.

#### func Parse

```go
func Parse(b []byte) (Frame, error)
```

Parse decodes exactly one APDU from b, which must hold the whole frame including the start and length octets and nothing else. The ASDU of an I frame aliases b.

#### func ReadFrame

```go
func ReadFrame(r io.Reader) (Frame, error)
```

ReadFrame reads exactly one APDU from r. It never reads past the end of the frame, so r needs no buffering for correctness. The returned ASDU is freshly allocated.

A clean end of stream before the first octet yields io.EOF; a stream that ends inside a frame yields io.ErrUnexpectedEOF.

### type Params

```go
type Params struct {
	// K is the maximum number of I frames a station may have outstanding
	// (sent but not acknowledged) before it stops sending. Range 1..32767,
	// default 12.
	K int

	// W is the number of received I frames after which a station must send
	// an acknowledgement at the latest. Range 1..32767, default 8. The
	// standard recommends W <= 2K/3.
	W int

	// T0 is the connection establishment timeout. Default 30s.
	T0 time.Duration

	// T1 is the timeout for an acknowledgement of a sent I frame or a
	// confirmation of a sent U frame. When it expires the connection is
	// closed. Default 15s.
	T1 time.Duration

	// T2 is the longest a station waits before acknowledging received I
	// frames when it has none of its own to send. Must be less than T1.
	// Default 10s.
	T2 time.Duration

	// T3 is the idle time after which a TESTFR act is sent. Zero disables
	// the idle test. Default 20s.
	T3 time.Duration
}
```

Params holds the IEC 60870-5-104 protocol parameters. Both stations of a connection must be configured with compatible values; they are not negotiated on the wire.

#### func DefaultParams

```go
func DefaultParams() Params
```

DefaultParams returns the default values from IEC 60870-5-104 clause 9.

#### func (Params) Validate

```go
func (p Params) Validate() error
```

Validate reports whether p is usable. It enforces the hard limits of the standard (1 \<= W \<= K \<= 32767, positive timers, T2 \< T1) and not its recommendations.

#### func (Params) WithDefaults

```go
func (p Params) WithDefaults() Params
```

WithDefaults returns p with every zero K, W, T0, T1 and T2 replaced by its default. T3 is left alone because zero is a meaningful value for it.

### type UFunction

```go
type UFunction uint8
```

UFunction is the function of a U-format frame, expressed as the first control octet (function bit plus the two format bits).

```go
const (
	// StartDTAct asks the controlled station to start data transfer.
	StartDTAct UFunction = 0x07
	// StartDTCon confirms StartDTAct.
	StartDTCon UFunction = 0x0B
	// StopDTAct asks the controlled station to stop data transfer.
	StopDTAct UFunction = 0x13
	// StopDTCon confirms StopDTAct.
	StopDTCon UFunction = 0x23
	// TestFRAct is the link test request.
	TestFRAct UFunction = 0x43
	// TestFRCon confirms TestFRAct.
	TestFRCon UFunction = 0x83
)
```

U-format functions. Exactly one is set in a valid U frame.

#### func (UFunction) Confirmation
